question: Are the theme custom post types reachable over the public WP REST API?
answer: NO. Definitively not. All are absent from /wp-json/wp/v2/types and all return HTTP 404.
method: Direct GET on each /wp-json/wp/v2/<type> route, plus cross-check against the full /wp-json/wp/v2/types map saved in types.json.
